title: Match Words with Deeds
subtitle: An AI-empowered proxy framework for organizational microfoundations

scenes.title: One decision, two explanations
scenes.visual_note: Two explanations lead to the same high research and development (R&D) spending. A second comparison pairs a bold public statement with limited investment. Both examples are illustrative.

scenes.title: How Figure 1 joins words and deeds
scenes.visual_note: Figure 1 joins a corporate-text branch and a separately chosen behavioral anchor. Researchers specify the construct, target, features, and any covariates for each application. Held-out predictions form the synthesized proxy; a separate outcome and component-proxy comparisons assess it.

scenes.title: Topic 224 and the deciding vote
scenes.visual_note: The selected trial is b1-gpt-6-astra-P0-xhigh. Initially A, B and C all voted to exclude Topic 224. After independent review of the same passages, A still voted to exclude it, while B and C voted to include it. Across the 12 trials, passage-review majorities retained 313–321 of 354 topics (88.4–90.7%). Reviewer reproduction checks the delivered rows and ordering. The historical alignment has limited independent provenance.

scenes.title: What the score actually predicts
scenes.visual_note: Five folds kept every firm and all firms linked through a CEO in the same fold. The score estimates same-year R&D/assets for 29,506 firm-years. Cross-fitted R² is evaluated on the 29,191 observations with a target. Of these, 12,452 with positive assets had missing R&D coded as zero. The metric uses the target winsorized at the full-sample thresholds. A signed residual records a departure from fitted behavior. Its cause needs separate evidence.

scenes.title: What the dividend test establishes
scenes.visual_note: The dividend-payer logit coefficient for the XGBoost score in the original column (8), with actual R&D controls, is −0.1423 (firm-clustered SE 0.0347; 2,927 observations, 591 firms). Table A13 in the final appendix adds a narrative proxy to eight R&D-adjusted specifications. All eight synthesized-proxy coefficients remain negative and significant at p < 0.01. The inside-debt estimates are −0.146 for Ridge and −0.141 for XGBoost. Table A13 is author-reported and is not covered by the repository’s existing 25-model connected reproduction.

scenes.title: What could change the interpretation?
scenes.visual_note: An industry shock can affect both earnings-call language and spending. A permutation test illustrates an alternative explanation. The appendix proposes carrying all twelve topic selections through learning and dividend assessment, prediction averaging, and selection-informed regularization. Human-reference assessment and independent construct validation remain open. The proposal reports a political-ideology trial whose results are not packaged here.
